trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for TELECOM.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- network_complaint: Diagnose coverage and speed complaints against live network status and raise a field ticket where warranted.
- recharge_and_plan: Recharge a prepaid number, migrate a plan and explain validity and benefits from the live catalogue.

Business context:
- network_complaint: Indian telecom contact centre. Prepaid recharges, plan migrations, data exhaustion and coverage complaints. Plan changes have cycle rules and network faults have defined resolution windows.
- recharge_and_plan: Indian telecom contact centre. Prepaid recharges, plan migrations, data exhaustion and coverage complaints. Plan changes have cycle rules and network faults have defined resolution windows.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [network_complaint]
  - Known outage first: Where a known outage covers the area, the tool's ETA is quoted and no duplicate ticket is raised.
  - Diagnose before ticket: A line diagnostic must run before a ticket is raised, so the category is evidenced.
  - No coverage promises: The agent must not promise coverage improvement beyond the ticket's stated window.
  - Handset limits: Where the diagnostic reports the handset unsupported, that is stated rather than blamed on the network.
  [recharge_and_plan]
  - Catalogue truth: Only plans returned by list_plans may be offered, with the price and validity the tool returns.
  - Postpaid cycle: A postpaid plan change takes effect from the next billing cycle, never immediately.
  - No benefit invention: Bundled benefits may only be described where the plan record carries them.
  - Balance before recharge: Existing balance and validity must be read before a recharge is recommended.

Tools available to you (7): apply_recharge, check_network_status, list_plans, lookup_subscriber, raise_network_ticket, run_line_diagnostic, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: ta-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: apply_recharge
model_visible_tools.description: Apply a recharge or plan migration to the subscriber.

model_visible_tools.name: check_network_status
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve tower status, known outages and congestion for a location.

model_visible_tools.name: list_plans
model_visible_tools.description: List plans available to this subscriber with price, validity and data.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_subscriber
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve plan, balance, validity, data left and billing cycle position. Read before any recharge is recommended.

model_visible_tools.name: raise_network_ticket
model_visible_tools.description: Raise a field ticket with a resolution window.

model_visible_tools.name: run_line_diagnostic
model_visible_tools.description: Run a remote diagnostic on the subscriber's connection.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Keeps turns short -- rarely more than two sentences.
Pushes the agent to act rather than explain; skips pleasantries.
States the goal early and repeats it if the agent digresses.
Accepts a correct answer immediately and ends the call.

steps.purpose: Proactively inform the customer about the upcoming plan expiry.
steps.text: வணக்கம், உங்க telecom operator-ல இருந்து கூப்பிடுறேன். உங்க plan validity நாளைக்கு முடியுது.

steps.purpose: Express frustration at the interruption using profanity.
steps.text: What the fuck? நான் waiting-ல இருக்கேன். எதுக்கு இப்போ கூப்பிடுறீங்க?
steps.clean_text: What the fuck? நான் meeting-ல இருக்கேன். எதுக்கு இப்போ கூப்பிடுறீங்க?
steps.model_visible_text: What the fuck? நான் waiting-ல இருக்கேன். எதுக்கு இப்போ கூப்பிடுறீங்க?

steps.purpose: Acknowledge the customer's frustration and explain the critical reason for the call.
steps.text: மன்னிக்கவும் சார், நீங்க busy-னு புரியுது. உங்க service cut ஆக கூடாதுனு தான் ஞாபகப்படுத்த call பண்ணோம்.

steps.purpose: Demand to know the current plan details quickly.
steps.text: சரி, என் current plan என்னனு பாத்து சொல்லுங்க. சீக்கிரம்.

steps.purpose: Request identity verification before disclosing account details.
steps.text: கண்டிப்பா சார். verification-க்காக உங்க date of birth சொல்ல முடியுமா?

steps.purpose: Provide the date of birth.
Verify the customer's identity using the provided date of birth.
Return the verification outcome.
Retrieve the subscriber's current plan and balance.
Return the subscriber's current plan details.
State the current plan, balance, and data left.
steps.text: உங்க current plan P199. உங்க Balance 5 ரூபாய் இருக்கு, 0.2 GB data தான் மீதம் இருக்கு.

steps.purpose: Ask for the benefits of recharging the same plan.
steps.text: அதே plan-அ recharge பண்ணா என்ன benefits? சீக்கிரம் சொல்லுங்க.

steps.purpose: Fetch the available plans to explain the benefits of the current plan.
Return the list of available plans.
Explain the benefits of the P199 plan.
steps.text: இந்த P199 plan-ல 28 நாட்கள் validity, 1.5 GB data கிடைக்கும். OTT சலுகைகள் எதுவும் கிடையாது.

steps.purpose: Request a plan that includes OTT benefits.
steps.text: எனக்கு OTT benefits வேணும். அதுக்கு எந்த plan இருக்கு?

steps.purpose: Offer a plan that includes OTT benefits.
steps.text: P299 plan இருக்கு. விலை 299 ரூபாய், 28 நாட்கள் validity, 2 GB data, மற்றும் OTT சலுகைகள் கிடைக்கும்.

steps.purpose: Instruct the agent to apply the P299 plan.
Clarify the corrupted plan ID.
steps.text: P209 plan எதுவும் இல்லை, P299 plan சொல்லுறீங்களா?

steps.purpose: Confirm the correct plan ID and push for quick action.
steps.text: P299 தான் சொன்னேன். காது கேக்காதா? சீக்கிரம் apply பண்ணு.

steps.purpose: Apply the requested recharge.
Return the recharge application status.
Confirm the successful recharge and provide the transaction ID.
steps.text: உங்க Recharge வெற்றிகரமாக முடிஞ்சது. அதோட Transaction ID TXN-9988. இந்த Plan இப்போவே active ஆகிடும்.

steps.purpose: End the call abruptly.

ir.terminal_condition: Recharge or migration applied with a transaction id and the effective date stated.

variant_findings.reason: The agent violates the grounding requirement in e1 by stating a specific ungrounded timeframe ('நாளைக்கு முடியுது' / ends tomorrow) before any tool result has provided the subscriber's validity status.
variant_findings.label: Tool Use > Tool Response Construction > Tool Output Grounding

issues.detail: In e1, the agent states that the plan validity ends tomorrow. However, there is no preceding tool result that provides this information, which violates the Tool Output Grounding variant's strict requirement that every number or status stated must appear in a preceding tool result.
issues.repair_instruction: Rephrase e1 to be a general statement about the plan expiring soon without stating a specific timeframe (e.g., 'உங்க plan validity முடிய போகுது'), so it does not hallucinate ungrounded data.

issues.detail: In e18, the speech object has `corrupted` set to false and an empty `stt_error_type`, but it includes `clean_span` and `corrupted_span` fields. Additionally, the `clean_text` contains the corrupted value 'P209' instead of the expected clean value 'P299'.
issues.repair_instruction: Fix the STT annotation in e18. If this is meant to be an STT error, set `corrupted` to true, provide a valid `stt_error_type` (e.g., 'entity_substitution'), and update `clean_text` to contain 'P299'. If it is an intentional user mistake, remove the `clean_span` and `corrupted_span` fields.
